description: Sim-to-real progression for synthetic p_shape lesion tasks, evaluated on 4 real OOD sources (isles22, shifts_ms, atlas_v2, gnc_kidney) all Dice ~0-0.08 on the pre-sweep checkpoint. Three stages, holding the pairwise-cleanest checkpoints from docs/logs.md's 2026-09-27/28 sweep (160-167): 0) baseline (135b, no shape-family training at all); 1) gmm_bank -- scatter_field painted onto the synthetic gmm_bank canvas (100% CT-sourced), isolated at 50% family-weight dose, brain-class-restricted host (checkpoint 162, 10 epochs from 135b); 2) scatter_field_real -- identical checkpoint lineage/dose/epoch-budget as 162, but the canvas swapped to a genuine real MRI TotalSeg subject via RealHostShapeProvider instead of the gmm_bank (checkpoint 163, 10 epochs from 135b) -- the one clean single-variable A/B in the whole sweep; 3) all_families_real -- the real-host mechanism extended from scatter_field alone to all 7 shape families, real CT+MRI mixed hosts, all organs (checkpoint 167, continues 166->165->164->163's own lineage, evaluated at epoch 320/400 where it was stopped). Confounds (epoch budget, deform, spacing range, CT-host mixing) are NOT controlled between stage 2 and 3 -- this experiment shows the progression, not an isolated ablation (that's 1_gmm_bank vs 2_scatter_field_real specifically, which IS a clean single-variable pair). All eval runs: experiments/3d/eval.py dataset=<ds> eval.model=patchset3d eval.checkpoint=<ckpt>, full deterministic dataset each time (the '+eval.tasks_per_class=20' flag present in some run args is a no-op for these 4 sources -- they route through build_dataset() in common.py, which never reads eval.tasks_per_class; verified n_samples is identical with/without the flag across every run here).
